calibration_sources: StreamingLLM: Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks (MIT HAN Lab / ICLR)
DuoAttention: Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference with Retrieval and Streaming Heads (MIT HAN Lab)
SnapKV: LLM Knows What You are Looking for Before Generation & H2O (Heavy-Hitter Oracle) Benchmarks

workload.model_and_context: 70B GQA Model (80 Layers, 8 KV Heads/Layer) at 128,000-Token Context (Full FP16 KV Cache = 40.0 GB per request!)
workload.attention_sink_physics: Because Softmax(QK^T) must sum to 1.0 even when the current token has no relevant match in history, autoregressive LLMs dump 45–80% of unneeded attention probability onto the very first 1–4 tokens (Attention Sinks). Evicting Token 0 breaks the Softmax denominator!
workload.head_specialization: Only ~20% of KV heads are 'Retrieval Heads' (attending globally across 128K tokens); the other ~80% are 'Streaming Heads' (only ever attending to the 4 Sink tokens + local recent window)!

tiers.name: Tier 1: 朴素滑动窗口 (直接丢弃开头第 0~3 个 Token · 触发 Softmax 崩溃乱码 ✕)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Naive Sliding Window Without Attention Sinks (Evicts Initial Tokens -> Softmax Perplexity Collapse)
tiers.recommended_for: Never use on pre-trained autoregressive LLMs without retraining; evicting Token 0..3 destroys the Softmax normalization sink.

tiers.name: Tier 2: StreamingLLM (保留开头 4 个 Sink Token + 局部滑动窗口 · 无限流式不崩但丢中间事实)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: StreamingLLM (4 Attention Sinks + Local Sliding Window -> Stable Perplexity, Loses Mid-Document Facts)
tiers.recommended_for: Infinite-turn casual voice/companion chat or live stream captioning where only the last few turns matter (not for long-doc RAG).

tiers.name: Tier 3: H2O 逐跳动态累计注意力驱逐 (需显式算注意力权重矩阵 · 与 FlashAttention 冲突)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: H2O Dynamic Heavy-Hitter Oracle (Requires Explicit Attention Matrix, Breaks FlashAttention Fusion)
tiers.recommended_for: Research baselines; maintaining per-step cumulative attention scores requires materializing O(N) scores and fragments PagedAttention.

tiers.name: Tier 4: DuoAttention (20% 检索头保留全量 KV + 80% 流式头仅存 Sink+滑窗) + SnapKV 前缀压缩 🏆
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: DuoAttention (20% Retrieval Heads Full KV + 80% Streaming Heads Sink+Window) + SnapKV Observation Pooling
tiers.recommended_for: Production 128K–1M long-context RAG & Coding Agents: shrinks KV cache by 71.5% (40GB -> 11.4GB) while retaining 99.2% NIAH recall and full FlashAttention speed.
